1st november 2026 ~ feast of all saints readers for the month of november - st. mary’s church - sat., vigil 6.30pm linda kiely, sun., 8.30am amal jaimon, sun.,11am denise mckenna. church of the resurrection – sat., vigil 7.30pm john mcdonnell, sun., 10am brigid collins, sun., 12 noon kay breen november indulgences for the holy souls praying for the faithful departed who are in purgatory is a traditional feature of the church’s life. the month of november is the month when this is emphasised most of all. in the first week of november plenary (full) indulgences may be gained for the holy souls. indu lgences are the remission before god of the temporal punishment due to sins whose guilt has already been forg iven. the faithful christian who is duly disposed gains the indulgence under prescribed conditions for either himself of the departed. indulgences are granted through the ministry of the church which, as the dispenser of the grace of redemption, distributes the treasury of the merits of christ and the saints. ind ulgences for the holy souls may be gained in one of the following ways: 1. from 12 o’clock noon on 1 november until midnight on 2 nove mber, all who have confessed, received holy communion and prayed for the pope’s intentions (one our father and hail mary) can gain one plenary (full) indulgence for the dead by visiting a ch urch, and there reciting one our father and the apostle’s creed. confession may be made at any time within the week preceding or the week following 1 november. holy communion may be received on any day from 1 november to 8 november. 2. the faithful who visit a cemetery and pray for the dead may gain a plenary indulgence applicable only to the holy souls once per day every day of november. the conditions mentioned above apply also for this. cemetery prayers in november st. gobnait’s ;
